target: hit_<fmt>: at least one fantasy-starter season (6+ games, PPR PPG above that format's replacement level: 12 teams, 1QB QB13/RB30/WR42/TE13, superflex QB25) in his first four NFL seasons. draft: Day 1 (round 1) / Day 2 (rounds 2-3) / Day 3 (rounds 4-7) / undrafted. Ranking metrics are scored against the mean of his best two PPR PPG seasons (0 if none).

calibration.method: logistic in raw log-odds + band offsets (per position)
